title: Pokemon TCG Japanese Leftovers Scarlet & Violet 160/165 Reverse Holo Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This Pokemon TCG card is a must-have for any collector! It features the card name Leftovers, number 160/165, and a reverse holo finish. The card is made of high-quality card stock material and is in standard size. 

The card is from the Scarlet & Violet set, manufactured by Nintendo in Japan in 2023. The card is in Japanese language and features artwork by Studio Bora Inc. It is a basic stage Pokemon card and is perfect for players aged 6 and above. This card is not autographed and is not a vintage item.
